description: Second connection: confirm the RPG III/DDS generator features added for Part 5 (tools/gen/rpg3.mjs E-spec/DS, tools/gen/dspf.mjs conditioning indicators + SFL) actually compile on PUB400. T0EDS is compiled AND run (no divide, no interactive I/O, so no hang risk - prints via QSYSPRT/EXCPT like the already-verified r0412s.rpg). T0SFL is compile-only (CRTDSPF): interactive subfile behavior needs a real 5250 device and cannot be checked over SSH batch (same V1-only limitation as lesson 04-11). IMPORTANT: T0SFL's conditioning indicators are not just unverified - lesson 04-11 already tried a DIFFERENT column layout (indicator number straight at column 7) and failed with CPD7410/CPD7606/CPD5238 (docs/probes.md). T0SFL uses a different layout (col7=A/O relation, col8-16=indicator groups); if it fails with the same CPD74xx/76xx/52xx family, treat that as corroborating evidence the column positions themselves are wrong, not a one-off fluke. Run after harness-selftest confirms the transfer/CCSID/INQMSGRPY basics.
